events.name: Spring Regional Competition
events.details:
Open regional competition for adult gymnasts of all levels.

- Four-piece apparatus for artistic
- Tumble track for tumble entries
- Medals for top three in each age band

Entries close two weeks before the event. **No late entries accepted.**

events.name: Adult Gymnastics Workshop: Back Handspring Bootcamp
events.details:
A half-day workshop focused on drills and progressions for back handsprings, suitable for beginners through to those polishing technique.

Coached by qualified artistic coaches. Limited to 24 places.

events.name: Emerald City Adult Open
events.details: The largest adult gymnastics meet in the Pacific Northwest, with sessions for all levels from novice to elite-track adults.

events.name: Winter Tumble & Trampoline League
events.details: Final round of the winter league. Entries are now **closed** — shown here so you can validate how closed entries render.

events.name: Acro Intensive Weekend
events.details: Two days of partner acrobatics and floor & vault technique. No entries date set on this one — used to validate events without entry dates.
